scenes.title: Идеальная семья  (The Ideal Family)
scenes.summary: Max introduces his new married life with Vika after returning from Paris, using financial news on television to tune out her nagging.

scenes.title: Герой нашего времени  (Hero of Our Time)
scenes.summary: A television crew films a documentary about Chef Viktor Barinov in the courtyard while he inspects produce from Timur and spars with Elena Pavlovna.

scenes.title: Два дня без любви  (Two Days of Patience)
scenes.summary: While Kostya and Nastya debate sending her little brother to his grandmother's, Vika tells Max that her doctor ordered two days of abstinence before her medical exam.

scenes.title: Интервью и важный гость  (The Interview and the VIP)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov records a grand speech about his culinary career for the documentary until Dmitry Nagiyev storms in and interrupts the shoot.

scenes.title: Роль Наполеона  (Playing Napoleon)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev explains that a film producer is coming to cast him as Napoleon in War and Peace and orders Viktor not to mess up the dinner.

scenes.title: В поисках недостатков  (Searching for Flaws)
scenes.summary: At the bar, Max complains to Kostya that Vika nags him over every little thing, and Kostya suggests finding a flaw of hers to even the score.

scenes.title: Сроки горят  (A Tight Deadline)
scenes.summary: When the television director warns Chef Barinov that she will film Elena Pavlovna instead if they have to wait, Viktor promises to persuade Nagiyev immediately.

scenes.title: Приезд мамы  (Mom's Arrival)
scenes.summary: Max discovers that Vika is frustratingly neat at home, while Nastya's mother unexpectedly decides to stay at the apartment.

scenes.title: Разговор на парковке  (Parking Lot Deal)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov catches Nagiyev outside the restaurant, learns that Nagiyev will be away filming all day, and secretly invites the TV crew back.

scenes.title: Блины от жены  (A Wife's Pancakes)
scenes.summary: Watching Kostya enjoy homemade pancakes from Nastya, Max realizes that in six months of marriage Vika has never once cooked for him.

scenes.title: Голодный как волк  (Hungry as a Wolf)
scenes.summary: Max flashes back to all the times he asked Vika to cook dinner at home and how she cleverly distracted him with romance instead.

scenes.title: Фуд-стилист на кухне  (The Food Stylist)
scenes.summary: While filming Chef Barinov's signature lamb dish, the television director brings in a food stylist who coats the meat with chemicals for the camera.

scenes.title: Продюсер уже в зале  (The Producer Is Here)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev returns early from his canceled shoot with the film producer, and Lyova rushes into the kitchen to warn Viktor.

scenes.title: Блюдо для съёмки  (The Prop Dish)
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov hides the camera crew in his office, a waiter serves the chemical-coated prop lamb to Nagiyev and the film producer.

scenes.title: Полгода без зарплаты  (Six Months Without Pay)
scenes.summary: Furious after biting into the lacquered prop lamb, Nagiyev storms into the kitchen and docks Viktor six months' pay while a hidden camera records Viktor's rant.

scenes.title: Первый блин комом  (The First Pancake)
scenes.summary: Coming home after work, Max claims to be too exhausted to cook dinner, prompting Vika to fry pancakes that turn out full of eggshells.

scenes.title: Спор из-за ужина  (Dinner Argument)
scenes.summary: Max teases Vika about the eggshells in her pancakes until she reveals she already passed her medical exam that morning, while Kostya and Nastya say goodbye to her mother.

scenes.title: Премьера фильма и увольнение  (The Broadcast and Firing)
scenes.summary: The staff and Nagiyev gather to watch Viktor's television documentary, which unexpectedly airs hidden-camera footage of Viktor insulting Nagiyev and gets him fired.
